MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Abigail.1: Some nonperishable spare stock has made its way in here.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Abigail.2: Looks like Pierre likes listening to music while he works.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Abigail.3: These are all Pierre's books. You refrain from looking too deeply into the bookshelf.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Abigail.4: Family photos. One of them looks like it's from the store's opening.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Abigail.5.false: A picture of Abigail when she was young. You've never seen her dressed this girly before.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Abigail.5.true: A picture of Abigail when they were young. You've never seen them dressed this girly before.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Abigail.6.false: Abigail must have drawn this when she was young.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Abigail.6.true: Abigail must have drawn this when they were young.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Abigail.7: Abigail's plants are still looking good.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Alex.1: Alex didn't bring any of his books along, just some magazines. Not surprising.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Alex.2: Everything is empty and immaculately clean.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Alex.3: This plant is new. You suppose it's the plant's room now. George and Evelyn don't seem to be using it.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Alex.4: You're pretty sure Evelyn was always the one taking care of these old plants.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Elliott.1: 'For Rent.' Elliott's renting out his old cabin to tourists.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Elliott.2: Elliott's old piano. You might move it out one day, but moving pianos is harder than you realized.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Elliott.3: You or Elliott can take care of the spiderwebs when this place gets a renter.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Emily.1: You're not surprised that there's some cobwebs with Emily moved out.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Emily.2: These are all full of old clothes and fashion magazines.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Emily.3: These are full of old shoes. So many shoes.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Emily.4: An old piece of exercise equipment. There was a brief trend for these. It looks barely used.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Haley.1: Some boxes of clothes. Emily must have kept some of the clothes Haley got rid of when she was moving to upcycle.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Haley.2: Emily's taking good care of Haley's plant.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Haley.3: Emily's taking advantage of the extra window space to get some plants some more sun.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Haley.4: Haley's dark room is still intact for now. She still stops by to use it every so often.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.EmilyHaley.1: Emily and Haley rotate weeks cleaning the house for their parents. Keeps the spiderwebs out.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Harvey.1: Harvey's kitchenette hasn't been cleaned in a while.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Harvey.2: Boxes of things Harvey didn't care about enough to lug them over to the farm.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Harvey.3: The books he left behind are all medical books he wanted to keep near his office.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Harvey.4: Spare divider curtains and chairs. You're not sure where he kept them before. Maybe he ordered spares.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Leah.1: Leah's phone, for when she loses track of time and needs to let you know she's crashing here for the night.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Leah.2: Leah still takes good care of her plants.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Leah.3: Leah's latest piece. It looks a lot like one of her old ones, but you know it won't when it's finished.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Leah.4: The shelves are full of books on sculpting.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Leah.5: A radio to listen to while working, if the mood strikes.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Leah.6: Crumpled old drafts and wood shavings, ready for recycling.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Maru.1: Everything's empty, though a bit dusty.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Maru.2: Locked. You think Robin uses it for storage for some work materials now.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Penny.1: Penny has so many books that plenty still got left behind. The shelves are much emptier than when she was here, though.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Penny.2: Everything is empty and dusty. Pam leaves the place alone, so Penny always has a place to return to no matter what.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Penny.3: The spiders are having a good time in here.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Sam.1: A new bookshelf, the kind that you can easily pick up at a store and assemble.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Sam.2: One of these is carefully wrapped china that probably hasn't been used in ages. Another contains old scrapbooks and old clothes.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Sam.3: Looks like Vincent and Jas have been doing art in here on the floor. Vincent will probably move in here when he's older.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Sam.4: This is full of cooking tools with oddly specific uses and trendy cookware. They don't look like they've been used much.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Sebastian.1: These boxes look like Robin's. Spare materials and tools, unsold pieces, etc.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Sebastian.2: Scrap wood, old ruined furniture. It has interesting grain patterns and textures for reuse in Robin's work.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Sebastian.3: This stuff is all labeled as being for the lab.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Sebastian.4.false: Sebastian moved the game table back here after he got his terrarium. He has plenty other spaces to play.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Sebastian.4.true: Sebastianu moved the game table back here after they got their terrarium. They have plenty other spaces to play.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Shane.1: Some of Marnie's stock has made its way into this spare room. Better than by the fireplace.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Shane.2: The room's been cleaned up nicely.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Olivia.1: The room seemed too empty without Olivia's things. This TV nook helps.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Olivia.2: The drawers are empty now. Seems like the place is set up as a guest room.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Olivia.3: The bookshelf has been picked over. Olivia brought many of her favorites when she moved out.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Scarlett.1: A bookshelf sits in place of Treyvon's desk now that he has a workspace of his own.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Scarlett.2: All of the books on this shelf are related to business. The spaces in between are carefully filled out with knickknacks.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Scarlett.3: Scarlett's old plant is looking good.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Sophia.1: The drawers are empty. Sophia didn't want to completely redo her childhood room.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Sophia.2: Sophia took most of her cosplay materials and sewing tools along with her.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Victor.1: The drawers are empty now. Seems like the place is set up as a guest room
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Victor.2: It's strange seeing this room without all the computer parts in it.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Victor.3: The bookshelves here are barer. Victor took his favorites along when he moved out.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Alissa.1: The room's been kept as it was before, aside from what Alissa packed to move.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Alissa.2: The shelf is barer without Alissa's favorite books.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.AntonKiarra.1: Stored dry goods. Probably stock waiting to hit the floor.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.AntonKiarra.2: Stored goods and equipment that used to be in the main room.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Blair.1: Blair's room is just as she left it, minus what she brought with her.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Corine.1: This all used to be in the front room. Probably nice to have it out of the way.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Corine.2: Kegs and preserve jars. These are either spares or damaged ones in need of repair.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Corine.3: More storage. Either some of Ezekiel's homemade beer or preserves, perhaps.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Faye.1: A fitting room! A step closer to this place looking like a nice little boutique.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Faye.2: Faye has needed to keep track of more things since her work took off. This computer helps.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Faye.3: This mannequin is useful for holding clothes up while making adjustments.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Paula.1: This locked door leads to a records room. Employees only.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Paula.2: Paula has a second examination room now, just in case it's needed.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Ian.1: This place hasn't gotten cleaner since Ian moved out.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Ian.2: This plate and cup have been sitting here long enough to gather dust.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Sean.2: There are sheets of paper on the desk with rows of carefully-written but messy letters.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.IanSean.1: Several boxes of miscellaneous stuff. No wonder the shop's front looks so clean now.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.IanSean.2: Several old tools. Either they're spares or worn out and awaiting repurposing or repair.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.IanSean.3: These contain rags and torn clothes that can be used as rags. Always a use for these in cleaning.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Kenneth.1: Just boxes and boxes of spare parts and bulbs for street lights.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Shiro.1: Yuuma's books are neatly organized. He has space for them all on the shelf now.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Shiro.2: Trinnie gave Yuuma this plant to celebrate him getting his own room. His name is Bobert the Brave.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Shiro.3: It looks like Yuuma stores his art supplies here.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Shiro.4: A toy robot! He is a scientist who can turn into a jet.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Shiro.5: A well-loved soccer ball. It used to be Shiro's.
MV.SpousesMoveHouse.Maddie.1: This lock box uses a code to enter. It contains keys, so a vacationing guest can get in.
